cohort: A total of 114,485 pregnant women who delivered at the Nanjing Maternity and Child Health Care Hospital between 2013 and 2018, comparing those who conceived through IVF with those who conceived spontaneously.
finding: In vitro fertilization (IVF) is associated with a significantly higher incidence and progression of preeclampsia (PE), with defective placentation and placental insufficiency potentially predisposing IVF patients to PE.
